finalText:
Builds clean now. Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That crash was killing the build entirely.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid instead of off, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`.

The rest was just deprecation noise from the bump, harmless. Build now finishes with 0 errors.
